model.name: Corporate Idea Implementation Framework
model.question: How does an organization systematically vet, fund, and transform employee or partner ideas into deployed capabilities?
model.summary: This model maps the enterprise pipeline for managing corporate innovations, connecting evaluation variables, strategic capabilities, operational apps, and historical incident checks.

layers.name: Strategy and Metrics
layers.role: Contains variables and capabilities. No raw application workflows belong here.

layers.name: Operations and Execution
layers.role: Contains processes, actors, and controls. No raw metrics belong here.

layers.name: Systems and Incidents
layers.role: Contains apps, integrations, and incidents. No human decision logic belongs here.

nodes.label: Minimum Projected ROI
nodes.note: Measured financial lookup value required for pilot greenlighting.

nodes.label: Rapid Prototyping Capability
nodes.note: Organizational competence in testing new business concepts.

nodes.label: Innovation Steering Committee
nodes.note: Cross-functional team responsible for funding authorization.

nodes.label: Idea Evaluation Pipeline
nodes.note: Step-by-step scoring framework applied to incoming proposals.

nodes.label: Quarterly R&D Budget Ceiling
nodes.note: Hard limit on total capital expendable across active pilot projects.

nodes.label: Enterprise Ideation Portal
nodes.note: Internal software used to submit and vote on new concepts.

nodes.label: Past Scaling Bottleneck Incident
nodes.note: Recorded historical failure due to missing integration capacity.

logic.goal: Evaluate whether submitted corporate ideas meet financial and operational criteria for pilot funding.

steps.name: Run ROI Check
steps.intent: Verify idea metrics against target variables

steps.name: Committee Review
steps.intent: Final committee voting and resource allocation
